glosses: skew, oblique, askew, leaning, slanting, aslant, inclined (neither parallel nor perpendicular)
slopy, sloping (characterised by a slope or slopes)
crooked, awry (set at an angle; not vertical or square)

examples.text: Alles, was schief gehen konnte, ging schief.
examples.en: Everything that could go wrong did.

examples.text: Was ist denn da schief gelaufen?
Heute ging von Anfang an alles schief.
examples.en: Today, everything went awry from the start.
